mentions.name: DIY ultrasound imaging system
mentions.description: This is a DIY ultrasound imaging system for seeing inside one's own body. A custom-manufactured analog front end streams 40Msps of data to a computer, and the builder is reverse engineering used convex medical probes with ~360 connections. The project involves substantial FPGA work, with AI assistance used for FPGA programming.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working in building an ultrasound system to see inside of myself.

So far I've got the analog front end manufactured and sitting on my desk able to stream 40Msps of data to my computer.
mentions.author: polishdude20
